description: This file defines the BannerRepository class, which interacts with an ApiService to fetch banner image URLs. It provides a method fetchBanners() that retrieves banners from the backend, filtering out blank entries, and incorporates error handling with fallback to an empty list.

classes.name: BannerRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for fetching banner image URLs from the backend API, providing a resilient method with fallback handling.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Fetches banner image URLs from the backend API, filters out blank links, and handles errors by returning an empty list on failure.
